messages:
jess.m: Heads-up — we need a 60m security/privacy review for Payments v2 rollout. Threat model + access review + audit prep. Who's free Tue/Wed next week? Need compliance + infra + product in the room.
kevin: Wed works for me, preferably 3pm PT. cc @maria @omar
maria: Wed 3pm PT is fine. Proposed agenda: 1) threat model walkthrough (15m) 2) access matrix review (15m) 3) audit artifacts & gaps (20m) 4) next steps & owners (10m)
omar: Works. Can someone prep current IAM spreadsheet and a sketch of third-party data flows? I can bring network diagram. Will link pre-read: `docs/payments-v2/threatmodel.md`
jess.m: I'll upload pre-read by EOD Mon. Can we add 'rollback criteria' to the agenda too? Also flag any PII handling exceptions we know about.
kevin: SG — I'll own the access review section. @security-bot can you create a calendar invite for Wed 3pm PT and include security@redwood.com and compliance@redwood.com?
security-bot: Created invite: Wed Mar 25 15:00 PT (60m) — https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abcd1234 :calendar: 
carol: For audit prep, we need a list of prior evidence (logs, config snapshots, runbooks). @maria can you add required artifacts to the doc? Also recommend we run a quick STRIDE checklist + sequence diagram during the threat model.
maria: Will add artifacts list + short checklist to pre-read. Also propose we record the meeting for audit notes/absentees.
jess.m: :thumbsup: Recording OK. One more ask — please create a masked staging test account with sample PII for the demo (no real data).
omar: I'll provision a masked staging account, ETA Tue.
jess.m: Thanks everyone — invite sent. If anything blocks, ping this thread and I'll escalate.
